species: mouse (C57BL/6); N2a mouse neuroblastoma cell line
readout_other: rotarod test; pole test; tyrosine-hydroxylase and TUNEL immunohistochemistry of substantia nigra; Nissl/H&E staining; CCK-8 cell viability assay; Annexin V-FITC/PI flow cytometry apoptosis assay; DCFH-DA ROS fluorescence assay; JC-1 mitochondrial membrane potential assay; TRPM7 mRNA expression
direction_notes: Study assessed neuroprotection (reduced dopaminergic neuron loss/apoptosis, improved motor function) rather than a direct excitatory/inhibitory neuromodulatory effect.
safety_notes: LIPUS alone did not cause cytotoxicity in N2a cells or tissue damage in mouse brain (H&E, Nissl staining); however, in a separate preliminary experiment mice exposed at a much higher intensity (Grade 5, ~355-427 mW/cm2) died on the third day of treatment.

exposures.label: In vivo mouse head LIPUS irradiation (Grade 2 intensity), MPTP model

target.label: mouse head (non-focusing cylindrical transducer aligned to head), assessed effect on substantia nigra pars compacta dopaminergic neurons

device.manufacturer: Institute of Ultrasound Imaging of Chongqing Medical University

timing.protocol_description: 10 min of ultrasonic irradiation delivered once every 24 h for 5 sessions total, in mice receiving MPTP (or saline) 4 days before LIPUS onset.

exposures.label: N2a cell culture LIPUS irradiation (Grade 1 intensity), MPP+ model

target.label: N2a cells (mouse neuroblastoma cell line) in culture

device.manufacturer: Institute of Ultrasound Imaging of Chongqing Medical University

timing.protocol_description: N2a cells were treated with LIPUS for 10 min, 4 h after MPP+ (0.75 mM) treatment; non-focusing cylindrical transducer placed under the culture plate.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: After removing the hair on the head of the mouse, the cylindrical transducer (diameter: 25 mm) with the medical ultrasound coupling agent (Chongqing Anijie Technology Co, Ltd, Chongqing, China) was aligned to the head for 10 min of ultrasonic irradiation (every 24 h, 5 times; Fig. 1a). A mouse was irradiated by ultrasound with a 1-MHz operating frequency, the intensity of Grade 2, 1000-Hz pulse repetition frequency, duty cycle: 20%, for 10 min, which was produced by Ultrasound Gene Transfection Treatment Meter (UGT 1025; Institute of Ultrasound Imaging of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China). The intensity of Grade 2 was measured by ultrasound power meter (Ohmic Instruments Inc., St. Charles, MO, USA). As measured previously, the energy of Grade 2 ranged from $1 2 3 \pm 2 . 7 8 1$ to $1 1 0 . 6 6 7 \pm 3 . 1 3 8 ~ \mathrm { m W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ (Zhou et al. 2018). All mice were sacrificed after LIPUS treatment, and brain tissues were preserved for histochemical staining. Animal behavioral tests were also performed throughout the experiment (Fig. 1b).

source_quotes.randomised: We purchased the 8-week-old, male C57BL/6 mice from the Experimental Animal Center of Chongqing Medical University (Chongqing, China) for this part of the experiment. All experiments were performed according to the guidelines approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of Chongqing Medical University. Mice were randomly placed into the following 4 groups: the control group (normal saline injection), the LIPUS group (only LIPUS irradiation), the MPTP group (only MPTP injection) and the MPTP+LIPUS group (LIPUS irradiation 4 days after MPTP injection). Intraperitoneal injections of 30 mg/kg MPTP (Sigma Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) or the same volume of normal saline were performed on the mice 5 times every 24 hours.
source_quotes.n_subjects: Brain tissues of each group were collected for histochemical staining after the pole test on day 17 (n = 5 for each group). Brain slices were incubated in rabbit antityrosine hydroxylase (TH) antibody (Abcam, Cambridge, MA, USA) overnight at $4 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and then incubated in goat anti-rabbit HRP IgG (Wuhan Servicebio Technology Co., Ltd., China) for 30 min at $3 7 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } .$ Quantitative analysis of the total number of TH-positive neurons was conducted. The number of TH-positive neurons was counted by ImageJ 1.52a (National Institutes of Health, Bethesda, MA, USA). All images were observed and photographed with a digital camera (Nikon Instruments Inc., Tokyo, Japan).

flags.reason: Paper gives per-group n (5 animals/group, 4 groups); only the LIPUS-exposed groups (LIPUS-only and MPTP+LIPUS) are counted here as [5,5]; total not stated.
Paper reports 'intensity of Grade 2' as measured by an ultrasound power meter without specifying whether this is ISPPA or ISPTA, and without specifying free-field vs in-situ domain.
Same ambiguity as Grade 2 (ISPPA/ISPTA and domain not specified) for the Grade 1 intensity used on N2a cells.
PRF (1000 Hz) and duty cycle (20%) are stated but pulse duration is never given directly; computing it would require arithmetic on the stated values, so it is left not_reported.
A separate, higher-intensity 'Grade 5' condition (~355-427 mW/cm2) caused death of mice by day 3; this was a preliminary safety observation, not part of the formally analysed Grade 1/2 exposures.
N2a cells were cultured in a well plate (dish) with no skull/tissue path; fields set to not_reported (rather than null) because the overall study also includes in vivo rodent exposures.
